title: Balance Carried Into a Pre-Visit Payment on the Insured Plan of Care
content:
Under the Insured Plan of Care, the balance the plan carries into a payment taken ahead of a visit leaves out charges still waiting for their statement:

- Where charges posted from an explanation of benefits (coinsurance or deductible charges) stand on the plan and no statement has yet been issued on it, only the time-of-service charges are carried, that is the deductible estimates and copays posted on the plan less the payments made on it, never below zero.
- Where the plan record shows a credit, nothing is carried, the credit being handled as a refund.
- Otherwise the patient balance shown on the plan record is carried.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Plan record balance | Explanation-of-benefits charges on the plan | Statements issued | Deductible estimates and copays posted | Payments made | Carried |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $210.00 | Yes | None | $155.00 | $100.00 | $55.00 |
| $210.00 | Yes | None | $80.00 | $100.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
| $210.00 | Yes | One or more | — | — | $210.00 |
| -$25.00 (credit) | No | — | — | — | $0.00 |
| $60.00 | No | — | — | — | $60.00 |
